submitted.rationale: Mg–Sb–O has a wide band gap, much larger than the 2.4 eV photons, so little photoresponse was expected. All five EQE values are near the noise floor (about ±2.5e-4 %). The two highest values came from the Sb-rich end: 0.757 Sb gave 2.5e-4 % and 0.670 Sb (near the MgSb2O6 trirutile composition) gave 1.6e-4 %. Index 26 had the highest measured EQE, but that ranking is not statistically meaningful.
